body:
A fix is ready. Branch: [`fix/3078-lightweight-test`](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/fix/3078-lightweight-test) - head `03d2c9d49762eedab255289f5e8b4df81ce65853`, one commit on top of `f24829636`. The patch in `git am` format is in the collapsed block at the end. **What's wrong** The red @yetone reported: `lightweight.test.cjs` run alone on origin/main `75e769a9f` fails 4 of 8 subtests (chromium and webkit, en and zh) with `posted []` at lightweight.test.cjs:86:14 - the switch was flipped, but no save was ever posted. **Root cause** The product was never broken - the click landed on nothing. Rows added above Settings - General had pushed the Off/On options past the 1000px viewport (the On option's middle at y about 1008 of 1000), so the helper's raw `page.mouse.click` pressed empty space; no save came, and after the 2.5 s poll the test read `posted []`. Main has been green since the page grew to 1200 tall (`28bec1507`, kept by `c627652e9`), but the trap stayed: rows keep being added to General, and the On option's middle sits at y 974 of 1200 now - about four rows of headroom before the same silent no-op click reads as `posted []` again. **The fix** The click helper now asserts, before the mouse click, that the option is wholly inside `#view-settings` and nothing drawn over takes the point pressed - the same check segs-glide's reveal has had since #2683. A row grown under the window's foot now fails at once with where the option is, instead of `posted []` after the poll. Broken by hand to compare: with this file's viewport at 900 (the option's middle at y 974), main's file fails `posted []`; this file fails at once with "the option is out of sight at (851, 974) of 900", in English and Chinese. **Verification** All runs today at `03d2c9d49762eedab255289f5e8b4df81ce65853` (base `f24829636`), macOS, playwright 1.62.0, Node v24.21.0: | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | `node --test lightweight.test.cjs`, 5 rounds | 8/8 pass in every round, exit 0 - including the four subtests that exercise the changed click helper: `chromium en`, `chromium zh`, `webkit en`, `webkit zh` ("lightweight mode is turned on and off in Settings - General") | | `git am` apply test | the patch am-applies onto `f24829636`; the applied commit's patch-id equals the branch commit's (`9d19baef0eb196e5266bf4f8fb489991a00de756`) | | latest upstream/main | the file under the patch is byte-identical between the patch's base and current upstream/main (11 commits since the base, none touch this file), so it still applies cleanly | **Not verified** - macOS with playwright 1.62.0 only; no other OS or playwright version was run. - In this re-run I ran only `lightweight.test.cjs`. The adjacent suites run earlier in this lane at this commit (`settings-general`, `segs-glide`, `segs-press-redraw`, two rounds each, green) are recorded in the commit message. - The API is faked in these tests (local fixtures; user settings and live gateways are never touched). **AI use** The patch was written by an AI agent (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode) under my direction; I ran and checked every item in the table above. The commit author stays `ggbdpq`, with the `Generated-by: GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode)` trailer in the commit. Thanks @yetone for the sharp report - the `posted []` excerpt and the run-alone recipe pinned the failing save down.
Patch, git am format - sha256 starts with 030aa071972573d8 ```diff From 03d2c9d49762eedab255289f5e8b4df81ce65853 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001 From: ggbdpq Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 02:58:11 +0800 Subject: [PATCH] gui tests: the lightweight click fails at once on an option out of sight (#3078) MIME-Version: 1.0 Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8 Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit The red reported on origin/main 75e769a9f ("posted []", 4 of 8, chromium and webkit) was the row under the window's foot: rows added above Settings › General had put the Off/On options past the 1000px viewport (y about 1008 of 1000), where a mouse click lands on nothing. No save ever came, and the failure read as an empty posted list. The product was never broken: 28bec1507 raised this test's page to 1200 tall (with the on-by-default change) and c627652e9 kept it, so the file has been green on main since. The trap stayed, though: rows keep being added to General, and one more row grown above puts the option under the foot once more, where the same silent no-op click reads as "posted []" again - the On option's middle sits at y 974 of 1200 now, about four rows of room. What changed: the click helper asserts, before the mouse click, that the option is wholly inside #view-settings and nothing drawn over takes the point pressed - the check segs-glide's reveal has had since #2683. A row grown under the foot now fails at once with where the option is, instead of "posted []" after the 2.5s poll. Broken by hand: with this file's viewport at 900 (the option's middle at y 974), main's file fails "posted []"; this file fails "the option is out of sight at (851, 974) of 900" at once, in English and Chinese. Run at origin/main f24829636 + this commit, macOS, playwright 1.62.0: - lightweight.test.cjs 10 rounds (chromium and webkit): 9 all-green; the one red round was settingsDrawn's 5s wait timing out on a box at load about 8, in a subtest that makes no click at all (the wait bar #4470 leaves at the click's 5s on purpose), green again on a rerun. - settings-general, segs-glide, segs-press-redraw: green, two rounds each. [process.env.BROWSER] : ["chromium", // one measured before that is gone (null) by the time it is clicked await page.waitForFunction(() => prefsBusy === 0); const b = await loc.boundingBox(); - await page.mouse.click(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y + b.height / 2); + // wholly in sight and on nothing drawn over: rows grown above put the + // row under the window's foot, the press landed on nothing, no save + // ever came, and the test read "posted []" (#3078) + const x = b.x + b.width / 2, y = b.y + b.height / 2; + const clear = await loc.evaluate((o, [x, y]) => { + const v = o.closest("#view-settings").getBoundingClientRect(), r = o.getBoundingClientRect(); + return r.top >= v.top && r.bottom <= v.bottom && o.contains(document.elementFromPoint(x, y)); + }, [x, y]); + assert.ok(clear, `the option is out of sight at (${Math.round(x)}, ${Math.round(y)}) of ${page.viewportSize().height}`); + await page.mouse.click(x, y); }; // another setting saved while it was never chosen leaves it unchosen, // so the default goes on applying -- 2.50.1 (Apple Git-155) ```
